name: Akazukin-kun to Ookami-chan
original_name: 赤ずきんくんとおおかみちゃん
source:
"You're no real wolf!"

"H-how could you..."

"It's in a wolf's nature to attack humans."

"...you're right."

"Now go!"

"I will!"

That's how a wolf girl ventured into the forest, all alone...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4197]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“你根本不是真正的狼！”

“你、你怎么能这么说……”

“袭击人类是狼的天性。”

“……你说得对。”

“现在走吧！”

“我这就走！”

就这样，一名狼女孩独自踏入森林……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/4197]Freem！[/url]]
